_comment: A cooldown summoning an owned, player-aligned Totem offset from the caster. The skill's level scales the totem's lifetime and loadout level; the owner's player level adds max health and a damage or heal multiplier, never crowd control. cooldownTicks matches the max-level lifetime only by convention: a shorter cooldown would let a player field more than one totem. All values placeholder.
name: SummonTotem
